dashboard.choosePlatformHelp: Choose one platform. Device checks and target selection happen on the next screen.
dashboard.recentSessionsSimpleHelp: Continue a recent test or open its report.
dashboard.packagedUnavailable: Packaged status unavailable. In dev mode, start pnpm dev:server.
dashboard.noDevicesMessage: Start the local-server to see Local PC and connected Android devices.
dashboard.recentSessionsHelp: Windows can sample process CPU/memory. Android Beta samples CPU, memory, battery, and network. FPS requires explicit PresentMon capture or experimental platform support.
error.failedToFetch: Could not connect to the local server. Confirm the desktop sidecar is running, or start pnpm dev:server in dev mode.
error.androidSystemScreenMessage: The phone is currently showing Android Settings or a system screen. Open the app or game you want to test, then click Start Test again.
history.noRecentSessionsMessage: Start a Windows or Android test to populate history.
history.localOnly: Showing local-only history because local-server is unavailable.
guide.title: How to use LumaTrace
guide.subtitle: Choose Windows or Android, follow the platform steps, start the test, then stop and read the report.
guide.mockBody: Mock Local Device is a built-in demo device. Its targets generate clearly marked mock metrics so you can learn the workflow without connecting hardware.
guide.pcBody: Local PC lists real Windows processes. Choose one process target to collect CPU and memory. FPS needs explicit PresentMon capture.
guide.androidBody: On the phone, enable Developer options and USB debugging, authorize this PC, open the app you want to test, then select that app here and start a session.
guide.deviceConcept: Device: the source to collect from, such as this PC or an Android phone.
guide.targetConcept: Target: the app, game, or process you want to measure on that device.
guide.sessionConcept: Session: one measurement run. Start it, watch metrics, stop it, then open the report.
support.title: Repair / Submit Bug
support.body: Try a safe restart and tool recheck first. If the problem remains, open the prepared GitHub bug form.
support.repairDescription: Restart local collection and recheck devices and tools.
support.repairingHelp: Restarting local collection and rechecking tools and devices.
support.repairSuccess: Repair completed. Tool and device status has been refreshed.
support.repairFailed: Automatic repair did not complete. You can submit a bug for follow-up.
support.submitDescription: Open the prepared GitHub bug form in one click.
support.submitFailed: Could not open the GitHub bug page.
support.include: Helpful details: app version, Windows/Android version, device model, what you clicked, what you expected, what happened, screenshots, and sanitized diagnostics export.
support.privacy: Do not include tokens, accounts, full local paths, raw logs, raw CSV files, logcat, bugreport, or private screenshots.
device.mockDescription: Safe tutorial data. Metrics are synthetic and clearly marked as mock.
device.localPcDescription: Real Windows process discovery and CPU/memory sampling.
session.beginnerBody: For your first test, choose Windows, select a running application process, click Start Test, stop after a few seconds, then open the report.
session.platformSubtitle: Start from the platform you want to test. LumaTrace will guide the next step and keep unavailable metrics as N/A.
session.platformWindowsBody: Choose an application or game process on this PC, then start testing. If the process exits, the session stops or records a clear interruption.
session.platformAndroidBody: Enable Developer options and USB debugging on the phone, authorize this PC, open the app you want to test, then click Start Test. LumaTrace detects the foreground package automatically.
session.runningHelp: Use the app normally. End the test when you have captured the scenario you want to measure.
session.defaultStep2: Follow the platform-specific connection or app selection prompt.
session.defaultStep3: Start the test after a device and target are selected.
session.choosePlatformFirstBody: After you choose Windows or Android, this area will show only the device, target, and start action for that platform.
session.windowsStep2: Choose the application process from Target.
session.windowsStep3: Click Start Test. CPU, memory, FPS, and frame time update live when PresentMon is available; otherwise FPS stays N/A.
session.androidStep1: On the Android phone, enable Developer options, turn on USB debugging, connect the USB cable, and authorize this PC.
session.androidStep2: Open the app you want to test on the phone.
session.androidStep3: Click Start Test. LumaTrace detects the phone's foreground app package automatically.
session.mockHint: Mock targets are only for learning the workflow. They are not real device or app metrics.
session.noPlatformDevice: No device for this platform yet.
session.androidForegroundPending: Open the app on the phone, then click Start Test. The package name will appear here after detection.
session.targetSearchPlaceholder: Type a name, for example java.exe
session.windowsVisibleAppsHelp: Open apps are shown first. Search also finds background processes.
session.noWindowsTargetMatches: No Windows process matches this search. Try another name or refresh targets.
session.exportLogsToReportDirHelp: Android saves a sanitized ADB logcat for the test period. Windows saves timestamped LumaTrace session records.
session.openReportAfterStop: Open the report for this run
session.noWindowsTargets: No running Windows application process was found yet. Open the app or game you want to test, then refresh the target list.
session.noAndroidTargets: No Android app target is available yet. Enable Developer options and USB debugging, authorize this PC, open the app on the phone, then refresh.
device.title: Device Detail
device.subtitle: Targets and metric availability for the selected local-server device.
device.androidHelp: Android Beta requires Developer options and USB debugging authorization. It supports explicit Start App / Stop App lifecycle controls, process rebind diagnostics, and sanitized cache/health status. CPU, memory, battery, and network sampling require adb. FPS remains experimental.
device.pcHelp: PC Beta lists local Windows processes and can sample PID-bound CPU and memory. FPS and frame time require PresentMon and remain experimental; executable paths are masked before display.
device.forceStopConfirm: This will force-stop the target package on the device.
device.cacheRefreshed: Android device and launcher cache refreshed.
session.title: Test Session
session.subtitle: Choose a platform, select the target app or process, start collection, then stop and read the report.
session.deviceNetworkNotice: Device-level network counters may include traffic from other apps.
session.uidNetworkNotice: UID-level network stats are estimated from dumpsys netstats detail.
session.androidNetworkNotice: Android network uses UID-level netstats when available and falls back to device-level counters with explicit precision.
session.androidFpsNotice: Android FPS/frame time is experimental and is tried during the test with public ADB frame stats. If Android does not expose matched frame data it stays N/A.
session.pcNotice: Windows tests automatically try realtime PresentMon FPS/frame-time when PresentMon is available. CPU and memory still work if PresentMon is missing. PresentMon availability: {availability}.
session.sampleIntervalHelp: Smaller numbers collect more often and make curves feel more live, but use more CPU. Larger numbers are lighter and better for long tests, but the curve is less detailed. 100 ms is a good default.
session.reportOutputDirHelp: Choose where test reports are saved. After a test ends, LumaTrace writes HTML, JSON, and CSV reports to this folder.
session.reportOutputDirUnavailable: Available after the local server reports a folder.
session.reportOutputDirChanged: Report folder updated. The local server was restarted safely.
session.reportOutputDirChangeFailed: Could not set the report folder.
session.reportOutputDirOpenFailed: Could not open the report folder.
session.simpleSettingsHelp: All other test settings use safe defaults. Missing metrics stay N/A and are never filled with 0.
session.autoStartHelp: Start App before session when PID is missing
session.monkeyFallbackHelp: Use monkey -p package 1 only when launcher discovery fails
session.stopTargetHelp: Force-stop target package after session stop
session.presentMonEnableHelp: Run explicit timed CSV capture for FPS/frame time
session.presentMonKeepCsvHelp: Keep temporary CSV until session cleanup for local debugging
session.androidFpsNaNotice: FPS and frame time remain N/A unless the experimental probe produces target-matched metrics. Ambiguous or missing layers are not converted into FPS.
session.pcCaptureNotice: The selected process is not started or stopped by LumaTrace. PresentMon capture is experimental. No matched PresentMon rows means FPS stays N/A.
session.autoStopped: The target app ended, so the test was finalized automatically and its partial report was saved.
session.restoreMissing: Last session could not be confirmed by the local-server.
session.waitingForMetricsMessage: Connecting to the target and waiting for the first real measurements. Charts will appear automatically when data arrives.
session.stopDialogMessage: Stopping flushes metrics and generates a report. It will not delete local history.
session.createDialogMessage: A session is already running. Stop it before switching sessions so collection stays explicit.
report.title: Test Results
report.subtitle: Choose a test result to view FPS, 1% low, frame time, CPU, memory, and exported reports.
report.deleteOneMessage: Delete {name} and its collected local data? Exported report files will be kept.
report.deleteAllMessage: Delete {count} completed local test results and their collected data? Running tests and exported report files will be kept.
report.recentResultsHelp: Select a completed or interrupted test to view its report.
report.noResultsMessage: Run a Windows or Android test first. The report will appear here after you stop the test.
report.coreMetricsHelp: Missing values stay N/A and are never filled with 0.
report.performanceGroupHelp: Start here: FPS shows smoothness, while 1% Low and frame time show stability.
report.resourcesGroupHelp: CPU, GPU, and memory used while this app or process was tested.
report.deviceGroupHelp: Power, GPU temperature, battery, and network data collected by the platform.
report.performancePoor: Average FPS is {avg}, below 30 FPS. Performance is poor and visible stutter is likely.
report.performanceFair: Average FPS is {avg}, between 30 and 59.9 FPS. Performance is acceptable, but demanding scenes may feel less smooth.
report.performanceGood: Average FPS is {avg}, at or above 60 FPS. Performance is good and the experience should generally feel smooth.
report.performanceUnavailable: Average FPS was not collected, so this report cannot rate rendering performance.
report.stabilityGood: 1% Low is {onePercentLow} FPS ({ratio}% of the average), indicating generally stable frame delivery.
report.stabilityNeedsAttention: 1% Low is {onePercentLow} FPS ({ratio}% of the average), indicating noticeable frame-rate fluctuations.
report.stabilityUnavailable: There is not enough 1% Low data to assess frame-rate stability.
report.performanceThresholdNote: These FPS bands are general guidance. The target frame-rate cap, display refresh rate, visual settings, and test scenario can change the interpretation.
report.rawPreview: Short reports use raw metric samples for the chart preview.
report.downsampledPreview: Long reports use bucket averages for the chart preview. Raw exports remain unchanged.
report.noTrendDataMessage: FPS, frame time, CPU, and memory charts stay N/A when no numeric samples are available.
report.exportHelp: This test lasted {duration}. {metrics} raw metric samples are available for export.
report.noPresentMonMessage: FPS and frame time stay N/A when capture is disabled, missing, unmatched, or ambiguous.
report.presentMonNotice: PresentMon capture is explicit and experimental. Reports do not include raw CSV content or full local output paths.
report.diagnosticsNotice: Exports are sanitized and do not include logcat or bugreport output.
tools.title: Tools / Diagnostics
tools.subtitle: Android and Windows tool status and diagnostics in one sanitized local view.
tools.securityNotice: ADB or PresentMon may be missing without breaking the app. Logcat, bugreport, root, cloud upload, and default monkey testing remain disabled.
tools.toolReason.unsupported: {tool} is not supported on the current operating system.
tools.toolReason.unknown: The status of {tool} could not be confirmed.
tools.toolAction.adbAvailable: Connect an Android device with USB debugging enabled.
tools.toolAction.adbInstall: Install Android SDK Platform Tools and make adb available.
tools.toolAction.presentMonAvailable: Enable PresentMon only when Windows FPS or frame-time data is needed.
tools.toolAction.presentMonInstall: Install PresentMon or configure its local path to enable Windows FPS capture.
tools.toolAction.checkConfiguration: Check the tool installation and local configuration.
tools.noPcDeviceMessage: PresentMon status appears when a PC device is available.
tools.presentMonDefaultReason: PresentMon capture is explicit and experimental.
tools.presentMonLimit.explicit: PresentMon capture must be enabled explicitly and remains experimental.
tools.presentMonLimit.noMatch: FPS stays N/A when the target cannot be matched uniquely.
tools.presentMonLimit.privacy: LumaTrace does not bypass Windows permissions or include raw CSV in reports.
tools.presentMonLimit.other: PresentMon reported an additional compatibility limitation.
tools.noDiagnosticsMessage: Errors and collector issues will appear here.
packaging.statusUnavailableMessage: Dev mode can continue to use pnpm dev:server.
packaging.check2: Bearer token is required for packaged REST and WebSocket.
packaging.check3: Token is not stored in VITE variables, localStorage, URLs, logs, reports, or diagnostics.
packaging.check4: Sidecar restart is limited and crash diagnostics are sanitized.
packaging.check5: Log rotation is enabled for app and sidecar logs.
packaging.check6: Packaged storage smoke verifies DB reuse after restart.
packaging.check7: Packaging notice manifests are generated and still require release review.
packaging.check8: Windows packaging release readiness stays blocked until production gates are complete.
packaging.check9: Production signing, updater, notarization, and store distribution are not configured.
packaging.rcNotice: This summary folds sidecar readiness, manual GUI QA, release policy, and RC gate evidence into one sanitized view. It is not release approval, and productionReady remains false.
metricQuality.title: Data quality
metricQuality.source: source: where the value came from
metricQuality.body: Unavailable metrics stay N/A and are never filled with 0. Demo data is marked as mock.
chart.nullsNotZero: missing values are not plotted as 0
marker.title: Event Markers
marker.label: Label
presentMon.permissionsBody: Realtime FPS needs one-time Windows performance tracing access. LumaTrace itself keeps running without administrator privileges, and CPU/memory remain available without FPS access.
session.fpsAccessBody: CPU and memory work now. Enable Windows performance tracing once to add FPS and frame time.
session.fpsAccessRestartBody: Sign out of Windows and sign back in once. Future tests run without administrator access.
session.fpsAccessErrorBody: CPU and memory are still available. Try checking again.
session.fpsAccessCancelledBody: Nothing changed. Continue with CPU and memory, or enable FPS later.
presentMon.retentionBody: Reports never include raw PresentMon CSV content. Local paths are sanitized before appearing in diagnostics or reports.
presentMon.noStatusBody: Create or start a Windows test to see capture status.
presentMon.defaultReason: PresentMon capture is explicit and experimental. FPS is emitted only after successful target matching.
pc.sourcePrecision: Windows FPS and frame time come from explicit PresentMon CSV capture and remain experimental. CPU and memory continue when PresentMon is missing or returns no data.
android.fallbackNetwork: Device-level network counters may include traffic from other apps.
android.fallbackMemory: Memory fell back to /proc/<pid>/status with lower confidence.
connection.label: Live connection
